title: Crewmate having a seizure
whenToUse: A crewmate has sudden shaking, stiffness or loss of awareness.

steps.text: Alert the crew and medical officer and start a timer now.
steps.detail: Track duration so you know immediately if convulsions exceed 5 minutes.

steps.text: Move hard floating gear away and cushion their head from module walls.
Do not restrain their movements and do not put anything in their mouth.
steps.caution: Never force food, liquids, pills or objects between their teeth.

steps.text: Once shaking stops, tether gently and check normal breathing for up to 10 seconds.
steps.detail: Keep airway clear until fully awake; switch to CPR if they are not breathing normally.

redFlags: The seizure lasts more than 5 minutes.
They are not back to normal in 5 to 10 minutes after shaking stops.
This is their first seizure or another seizure starts without recovery.
They have trouble breathing, vomiting or a head injury.

escalation.text: Red flag or getting worse? Alert a crewmate now. Do not wait for Earth.
